name: Transcendent Spell [Metamagic]
body:
Your magical abilities replicate the strange techniques of psionics.

Benefit(s): The spell cast using this feat is treated as a psionic power of no particular discipline for all purposes (feats, class abilities area effects, power resistance, etc.). This does not allow metapsionic feats to be applied to the spell.

Level Increase: +2 (a transcendent spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell’s actual level.)
